text: Due to the particularity of the flow of the storehouse consciousness, the view that all [seeds] are capable [of manifesting] renders the projection of time untenable. Therefore, to explain the quality of occasionality, it should be delimited—without concealing one's own experience—by the four [conditions] and by a mind that has obtained even the undesired, [recognizing] that the six objects (sound, touch, form, taste, smell, and pleasure etc.) and the four conditions arise in dependence upon [other] conditions.
